## History

Maurice Lennox was a fictional character created by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to serve as the antagonist in her story. As the designated villain of her narrative, he was ultimately written to be punished for his actions.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Atonement” P30](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0030)_

## Relationships

### [Perceval](../character/perceval.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/maurice-lennox--perceval.md)

In Anne's story, Maurice Lennox and [Perceval](../character/perceval.md) are portrayed as fierce rivals who compete for the affections of [Averil](../character/averil.md). Their antagonistic dynamic extends further as Maurice actively faces persecution at Perceval's hands within the narrative. Their relationship remains defined by this ongoing conflict and competition.

- Enemy of — persecuted by him in Anne's story  <sub>[v3 ch.Atonement” P32](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0032)</sub>
